info.title: Beachrex API
info.description:
This is the API documentation for the Beachrex backend. Some of the endpoints use token-based authentication via Laravel Sanctum.

 **Authentication**

All protected endpoints require an `Authorization` header:

Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_TOKEN

You can get your token via the `/api/v1/login` endpoint.

get.summary: Get map bounds for all active beaches
get.description: Returns only the bounding box and center coordinates of all active beaches (status_id=1). Used for initial map load to calculate proper zoom and center. Does not return beach data. This endpoint is heavily cached (30 days TTL) and cache is automatically cleared when beaches are updated.

X-Cache-Status.description: Cache status: HIT (from cache), MISS (from database), or BYPASS (not cached)

X-Cache-Key.description: The cache key used for this request

X-Locale.description: The locale used for this response

get.summary: Resolve a slug to determine its entity type
get.description: Determines whether a slug represents a region, island, city, or beach. This is useful for dynamic routing where the URL structure can vary. Returns the entity type and basic information.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: The slug to resolve (e.g., kvarner, island-cres, split)

parameters.name: country_code
parameters.description: Optional country code to narrow down the search (e.g., HR, SI, IT)

parameters.name: parent_slug
parameters.description: Optional parent slug to provide context (e.g., if resolving a city within an island, pass the island slug)

parameters.name: segment_count
parameters.description: Optional number of segments in the URL path to help determine entity type (1=region/island, 2=city, etc.)

beaches_count.description: Number of beaches
